title: The wall: rotating cover-art carousel on the home page
spec: Home page is a carousel of cover art that is pleasant to just look at — this is the whole reason the project is not a spreadsheet. Rotates BOTH by click-and-drag (pointer events, momentum, snap to nearest) AND by buttons on either side. Cards show poster art, title, year and kind. Clicking a card opens its title page (T-6). Works with 1 title, with 200, and with 0 (a real empty state that invites adding something, not a blank screen). Keyboard arrows step it; respects prefers-reduced-motion by dropping to instant transitions. Fully skin-driven — no hardcoded colours, only tokens from T-2. ACCEPT: drag rotates it under the cursor and settles cleanly; the side buttons step exactly one card; it looks right in every shipped skin.
